findings.title: Broken self-correction residue in install verify-step
findings.recommendation: Replace the comment `# 15 total (12 upstream + 4 orbit + ... actually 16 with the four new + 12 upstream)` with the correct, clean comment `# 15 total (11 upstream openspec-* skills + 4 new orbit skills)`. The current text is a mid-edit self-correction left in place; the math `12 + 4 = 16` is wrong, and the prose is broken. This is exactly the residue class the change-completeness discipline (now codified in orbit-conventions and CLAUDE.md) is designed to prevent. Meta-validation: the very command running this review is part of the same overlay whose authoring left this residue.
